note: A group whose contents is not the same object as expandedStates[0] (possible via group(contents, {expandedStates}) or stripTrailingHardline on a conditionalGroup). Prettier propagateBreaks walks only expandedStates of such a group (traverse-doc.js, shouldTraverseConditionalGroups), so the inner group in contents keeps break:false and prints flat; port.rs propagate() also walks contents (`let _ = propagate(contents, shared)`) and breaks it. Prettier is the reference, so the port is wrong here.
